description: This prompt instructs an image-generation/editing model to combine two separate reference photos into a single realistic, influencer-style “bestie” selfie of two female friends sitting close together inside a modern car, explicitly assigning the first input to the left subject and the second input to the right subject. It emphasizes strict identity preservation (no blending, no changes to facial structure, ethnicity, or age), adds light natural beauty retouching and trendy styling/accessories, and specifies a front-camera selfie composition with bright daytime natural light, soft warm tones, subtle realism-enhancing texture, and no text or watermarks, resulting in a polished but believable photograph.
